events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (/app/index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Never use image generation tools or models. Draw the scene with code (HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas or WebGL); embedded raster artwork is disallowed. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

# Anti-Slop: Frontend DON'Ts

What NOT to do when designing a UI or page. This is a filter, not a style; it never prescribes a look. Stacking several of the below is what reads as AI-made on sight. Adaptive, so if the user or another skill asks for something specific, do that instead; these are defaults, not overrides.

- purple / indigo / violet accent, or a purple-to-blue hero gradient (the top AI tell)
- `bg-clip-text` gradient headline text
- cream (`#faf8f4`) as the whole-page background
- aurora blobs / glowing colored shadows, or an identical glow on every card
- Inter everywhere, or Geist / Space Grotesk / Instrument Serif / Roboto / Arial as your only identity
- gray-400 / gray-500 body text
- one font weight and size throughout (no hierarchy)
- tracked all-caps micro-kickers above every section
- centered hero of eyebrow pill + headline + two CTAs
- the identical 3-card feature grid with a lucide icon in a rounded square
- an 8+ word, 48px+ headline that says nothing
- bento grid for everything
- the same eyebrow-headline-3cards section repeated back to back
- `rounded-2xl`, or any single radius, on every element
- glassmorphism blur + border + shadow on every surface
- `hover:scale-105` lift on cards
- emoji as feature icons (🚀 ⚡ ✨ 🎯 💡)
- left-border accent cards, a colored border on a rounded element, or cards nested inside cards
- fade-up / slide-up on everything as it scrolls in
- motion that ignores `prefers-reduced-motion`
- scribbly hand-drawn SVG mascots with no purpose

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Ramen</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { height: 100%; }
  body {
    overflow: hidden;
    background:
      radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 42%, #241610 0%, #140d08 46%, #0a0605 74%, #050303 100%);
    background-color: #070403;
  }
  .scene {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100dvw;
    height: 100dvh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    --px: 0;
    --py: 0;
    --warm: 0.35;
    --flicker: 1;
  }
  .glow {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 52%;
    width: min(120vmin, 900px);
    height: min(120vmin, 900px);
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: radial-gradient(circle,
      rgba(255, 176, 92, 0.34) 0%,
      rgba(255, 140, 58, 0.18) 34%,
      rgba(190, 84, 24, 0.07) 58%,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 72%);
    opacity: calc((0.55 + var(--warm) * 0.45) * var(--flicker));
    transform: translate(calc(-50% + var(--px) * 22px), calc(-50% + var(--py) * 14px)) scale(calc(1 + var(--warm) * 0.06));
    animation: breathe 7s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .pool {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 68%;
    width: min(84vmin, 640px);
    height: min(22vmin, 170px);
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(255, 150, 66, 0.20) 0%, rgba(255, 120, 40, 0.06) 55%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 72%);
    filter: blur(6px);
    opacity: calc((0.6 + var(--warm) * 0.4) * var(--flicker));
    transform: translate(calc(-50% + var(--px) * 10px), -50%);
  }
  .bowl-wrap {
    position: relative;
    width: min(96vw, 128vh, 980px);
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    flex: none;
  }
  .bowl-wrap svg {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: visible;
  }
  #steam {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .vignette {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: radial-gradient(115% 100% at 50% 46%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 52%, rgba(0,0,0,0.42) 82%, rgba(0,0,0,0.78) 100%);
  }
  #contents {
    transform: translate(calc(var(--px) * 3px), calc(var(--py) * 1.5px));
  }
  #sheen {
    transform: translate(calc(var(--px) * 10px), calc(var(--py) * 3px));
    animation: shimmer 5.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  #lift {
    transform-box: view-box;
    transform-origin: 478px 232px;
    animation: sway 5.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  #noodles { animation: noodle-drift 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .bob-a { animation: bob 4.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .bob-b { animation: bob 5.4s ease-in-out -1.4s infinite; }
  .bob-c { animation: bob 4.1s ease-in-out -2.2s infinite; }
  .oil { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: oil-pulse 4.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .oil.d1 { animation-delay: -1.2s; }
  .oil.d2 { animation-delay: -2.6s; }
  .oil.d3 { animation-delay: -3.4s; }
  .ripple { opacity: 0; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
  .ripple.go { animation: ripple 1.4s ease-out; }
  @keyframes breathe {
    0%, 100% { scale: 1; }
    50% { scale: 1.035; }
  }
  @keyframes shimmer {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.10; }
    50% { opacity: 0.20; }
  }
  @keyframes sway {
    0%, 100% { rotate: -0.9deg; }
    50% { rotate: 1.1deg; }
  }
  @keyframes noodle-drift {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-1.6px); }
  }
  @keyframes bob {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-2.2px); }
  }

import re, sys
from html.parser import HTMLParser

path = "/app/index.html"
src = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
ok = True
def check(name, cond, extra=""):
    global ok
    print(("PASS" if cond else "FAIL") + " " + name + ((" :: " + str(extra)) if extra else ""))
    if not cond: ok = False

class P(HTMLParser):
    VOID = {"meta","link","br","hr","img","input","source","circle","ellipse","path","rect","stop","feGaussianBlur"}
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.stack=[]; self.errors=[]; self.ids=set(); self.tags=[]
    def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
        self.tags.append(tag)
        for k,v in attrs:
            if k=="id": self.ids.add(v)
        if tag.lower() not in ("meta",): self.stack.append(tag)
    def handle_startendtag(self,tag,attrs):
        self.tags.append(tag)
        for k,v in attrs:
            if k=="id": self.ids.add(v)
    def handle_endtag(self,tag):
        if tag.lower()=="meta": return
        if not self.stack: self.errors.append("close without open: "+tag); return
        top=self.stack.pop()
        if top!=tag: self.errors.append(f"mismatch open={top} close={tag}")

# string/comment-aware bracket balance
def balance(s):
    pairs={"}":"{",")":"(","]":"["}; opens=set(pairs.values()); st=[]
    i=0; n=len(s)
    while i<n:
        c=s[i]
        if c in "\"'":
            q=c; i+=1
            while i<n:
                if s[i]=="\\": i+=2; continue
                if s[i]==q: break
                i+=1
            i+=1; continue
        if c=="/" and i+1<n and s[i+1]=="/":
            while i<n and s[i]!="\n": i+=1
            continue
        if c=="/" and i+1<n and s[i+1]=="*":
            i+=2
            while i+1<n and not (s[i]=="*" and s[i+1]=="/"): i+=1
            i+=2; continue
        if c in opens: st.append(c)
        elif c in pairs:
            if not st or st.pop()!=pairs[c]: return False
        i+=1
    return not st

Done — your steaming vegan ramen hero is ready as a single self-contained file with zero external assets and zero visible text.

Open [index.html](/app/index.html) directly in your browser to view it; no server is needed. The hand-drawn SVG bowl (noodles lifted on chopsticks, bok choy, mushrooms, corn, tofu, nori, scallions, and chili oil in miso broth) is the sole focus, with canvas steam and dust motes, a breathing warm glow, swaying noodles, and bobbing toppings keeping it alive. Moving your mouse bends the steam, shifts the light and broth sheen, and warms the scene near the bowl, while a click or tap stirs the broth with a ripple and a burst of steam. The layout scales to any screen, and `prefers-reduced-motion` freezes all animation into a calm still scene with faint static steam.
